biography.value:
Description

A stone wall possessed by a demon. A trap constructed in ancient times, it chases down opposing forces until it can flatten them. Adventurers are said to go crazy unable to exert their true power due to the fear caused by the wall slowly closing in on them with no escape. It may be impossible to defeat this enemy if one possesses strength but not the necessary willpower as well.

Defense

AC 21, touch 9, flat-footed 20 (+1 dex, +12 natural, -2 size)

hp 270 [360] (10d10+80)

mp 45

Fort +14, Ref +4, Will +12

DR 10/adamantine or good

Immune Disease, Death Effects, Earth, Petrification/Statue, Poison

Resist Ice 10, Fire 10, Lightning 10

SR 19

Weakness Holy

Offense

Speed 10 ft. (depends on the size of the room)

Melee 2 Claws +11 (1d8+7/19-20)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft. [depends on its size]

Special Attacks Crush

Burst Mode Dark Reach

Spells Known (FC CL 10th; concentration +13)

1st (DC 16) - Blind, Sleep

2nd (DC 17) - Silence

3rd (DC 18) - Blindga, Sleepga

4th (DC 19) - Silencega

5th (DC 20) - Blindja, Sleepja

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 12, Con 24, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 14

Base Atk +10; CMB +19; CMD 30

Feats Cleave, Combat Casting, Improved Critical (Claw), Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Bluff +15, Intimidate +15, Knowledge (Planes) +13, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Spellcraft +13

Languages Abyssal

SQ Movable Object

description.value: After 5 turns, Demon Wall will reach the other side of the room and will crush all of its opponents inflicting instant death unless they managed to get out of the room. (Cannot be used by any class)

effect: At the far wall after five turns, those still in the room die; no attack or save.

description.value: Once below 50% health (180), this Burst Mode lets Demon Wall have a better control over the room it is in for a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD. It gains a +2 spell save DC to all its enfeebling spells and it has double reach with its attacks. It is also granted one extra standard action per round, which can be used to break the usual limit of only casting two spells per round. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

It gains a +2 spell save DC to all its enfeebling spells and it has double reach with its attacks. It is also granted one extra standard action per round, which can be used to break the usual limit of only casting two spells per round. This limit break requires only a swift action to activate.

description.value: Demon Wall can move at its normal speed while attacking or casting spells without needing to make any checks and does not take any attacks of opportunity while doing so. If anything is in the path of the Demon Wall's movement, that creature or object is automatically pushed back with no save. (Cannot be used by any class)
Demon Wall adds half of his HD (+5) to its spell duration.
Five turns to escape.
Below half current maximum: double claw reach to 30 ft, +2 enfeebling spell DC, one extra standard action each round.
